title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England for review and approval pursuant to G.L. c. 164, sec. 94 and 220 CMR 5.03, of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Simmons College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds thet the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Jr., Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-4)
